label: Search workspace
description: Find workspace Markdown, text, and JSON by content, filename, display title, or tags using persistent SQLite FTS5 BM25. Any query word may match; results are ranked by relevance with higher scores better and compact excerpts. Use kinds to narrow to notes or canonical summaries. Read the selected path with read_research_note before relying on details; excerpts and notes are not full-source evidence. Application writes update the index automatically. Use workspace_index action=refresh only after external edits, file additions/deletions, or suspected stale results. This does not search PDF source bodies; use read_research_paper action=search for those.

parameter_descriptions.query: Plain lexical query (1 to 2000 characters), or JSON null to browse. Words are OR-matched; punctuation is not FTS syntax. No semantic or substring matching.
parameter_descriptions.kinds: Workspace document kinds to include; use an empty list for all kinds.
parameter_descriptions.tags: Tags that should constrain results; use an empty list for no tag filter.
parameter_descriptions.limit: Maximum number of compact matches, from 1 to 50.
parameter_descriptions.offset: Zero-based result offset, or null for the first page. Add limit to continue until a page is shorter than limit.
